rca of the issue: Nested-button hydration warning: Workspace.jsx renders each doc row as <button data-testid='doc-open-{id}'> ... </button> and inside that outer button it also renders the trust Select component which internally renders <button role='combobox'>. HTML spec forbids nesting interactive elements; React logs this and it can cause hydration mismatches. Reproduction: login → /app/workspace → open DevTools console → error appears immediately. Mitigation: (a) change the outer doc-open to a <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={Enter→click}> OR (b) move the trust Select outside the doc-open wrapper (e.g. into a sibling flex cell) so the Select's trigger button is not a descendant of the doc-open button.
